title: Cosmic Cat Entity
description: A surreal night scene features a giant patchwork cat-like creature with multiple eyes and a wide grin, its body composed of stitched fabric patterns and embedded circular vignettes showing smaller scenes including a silhouetted hiker. In the foreground, a backpacker with a walking stick stands on a geometric rocky outcrop beneath the creature, surrounded by twisted leafless trees, lavender flowers, crystals, and a starry green cosmic sky with constellations and a red planet.
prompt: Surreal fantasy night scene with a massive patchwork cat-like monster made of stitched beige fabric with multiple large white eyes and a huge toothy grin, its body containing circular portals showing a silhouetted hiker in a field of lavender, the creature entwined with gnarled leafless trees, a small human backpacker with walking stick standing on geometric crystal rocks in the foreground, dark green starry cosmic sky with constellations and red planet, black ink linework with watercolor washes and purple lavender accents
